--- original
+++ modified
@@ -0,0 +1,50 @@
+---
+assignees:
+- claude-code
+position_column: todo
+position_ordinal: '8580'
+title: The fork-tree restoration test fits the two-minute budget by 5 percent, and the 30B's sampling decides which run
+---
+Filed by task ^k0d30s4, which gave every test of `FoundationModelsRouterIntegrationTests` a wall-clock budget of two minutes and stated that budget as each suite's `.timeLimit`.
+
+## The measurement
+
+Two whole runs of `swift test --package-path IntegrationTests` on one Apple silicon box on 2026-08-20, with every model in the Hugging Face cache. The full table is in the doc comment of `integrationTestBudgetMinutes`, in `IntegrationTests/Tests/FoundationModelsRouterIntegrationTests/Support/GatedSuiteSerialGate.swift`.
+
+| test | run 1 | run 2 | share of the budget |
+|---|---|---|---|
+| `SessionTreeRestorationIntegrationTests/restoresWholeTreeAcrossSimulatedProcessBoundary` | 94.1 s | 114.1 s | 95 percent |
+| `RealToolTurnComparisonTests/realTurnDeliversToolDataOnBothSurfaces` | 86.7 s | 85.3 s | 72 percent |
+| `LanguageModelSessionBackendIntegrationTests/makeForkSeedsFromParentTranscript` | 28.8 s | 62.3 s | 52 percent |
+| `SessionTreeRestorationIntegrationTests/restoredSessionCallsThreadedTool` | 54.4 s | 61.7 s | 51 percent |
+
+Every one of them fits, so task ^k0d30s4's first acceptance criterion holds as measured. The first one fits by 5.9 seconds.
+
+## Why the numbers move so much
+
+These suites load `RealModels.standard` (`Muse-Glimmer-30B-4bit`) and take the PROVIDER DEFAULT sampling: temperature 0.6 from MLX's clock-seeded process-global PRNG. The 30B always writes a `<think>` block before its answer, and that block is a different length on every run of identical code. `makeFork()` measured 28.8 s and then 62.3 s — 2.2 times — with no code change between the two runs.
+
+So a run alone decides whether the fork-tree restoration test clears 120 seconds. When it does not clear it, the time limit cancels the test mid-generation, and a cancellation that lands on GPU work aborts the whole process on a Metal assertion rather than failing one test (fork card ^3axg80k). The whole run's results are lost with it.
+
+## What to build
+
+Bring `restoresWholeTreeAcrossSimulatedProcessBoundary` well inside the budget, and pick the technique the way task ^k0d30s4 asks: state what the converted test no longer proves.
+
+The test drives five real turns and two model loads. Three of the five turns say `"Say hi in one word."` and exist only to give each fork a recorded turn, so that the sync-as-they-happen check has something to read. Each of those turns pays for a 30B `<think>` block.
+
+Two techniques are already proven in this repository, and either or both can apply:
+
+1. **Pin the sampling.** `RealModelContainer.load(ref:)` here states no `samplingMode`, so it takes the temperature-0.6 default. `CompactionRoundTripIntegrationTests`, `CompactionSmokeIntegrationTests` and both gated eval runners pin `.greedy`, and each states the same measured reason: argmax decoding consumes no randomness, so a red run can be attributed to the change under test. This removes the spread. It does not by itself make the test faster.
+2. **A small model.** Task ^k0d30s4 moved `CompactionRoundTripIntegrationTests` from the 30B to `mlx-community/Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct-4bit` and it fell from 541.6 s to 17.4 s, with its fact-recall assertion still green.
+
+Note the risk before choosing 2 for this file: the suite's SECOND test, `restoredSessionCallsThreadedTool`, asserts that a restored session really calls the echo tool — it requires `.toolCalls` and `.toolOutput` entries on disk. A model swap has to keep that green. Measure it, do not assume it.
+
+## Acceptance Criteria
+
+- [ ] `restoresWholeTreeAcrossSimulatedProcessBoundary` measures under half of `integrationTestBudgetMinutes` across two runs of the whole target
+- [ ] The sampling this suite decodes with is stated, not inherited from the provider default
+- [ ] Both tests of the suite stay green, `restoredSessionCallsThreadedTool` included
+- [ ] The suite doc states what the conversion no longer proves, as `CompactionRoundTripIntegrationTests` does
+- [ ] The two-run table in `integrationTestBudgetMinutes` records the new measurements
+
+#test-debt #real-model #integration
\ No newline at end of file
